exclusives.description: LL shall not, in future leases or agreements encumbering the Center, lease to any other tenant for the Initial Primary Use. (3rd Amendment replaces §3: no sale of groceries, meats, fish, produce, dairy, bakery, or packaged alcoholic beverages for off-premises consumption; incidental sale allowed up to the lesser of 1,000 SF or 10% of an occupant's space, or via a retail fulfillment center for digital delivery; no drugstore or pharmacy department.)

goDark.value: If Tenant ceases to use the Premises for more than 60 days, Landlord may terminate on notice (1st notice). If Tenant ceases again after the 1st notice for more than 30 days, Landlord may terminate (2nd notice); and a third time after the 2nd notice for more than 30 days (3rd notice). (Landlord-favorable — three-strike termination right.)

assignment.value: Landlord's prior written consent required, except for transfers to certain related parties (Kroger affiliates). No fee.

camTax.value: CAM: Pro-Rata = built ground-floor SF of the Premises ÷ built ground-floor + above-ground retail SF of all Center buildings; no admin fee; management fee included; Tenant pays its PRS of common-area capital improvements (e.g., parking-lot resurfacing). Monthly estimate with annual reconciliation. Taxes: Pro-Rata if not separately assessed (else paid directly); standard exclusions; no admin fee or cap; Landlord provides receipt within 30 days of final payment.

defaultTerms.value: Monetary: within 10 days after Landlord's written notice. Non-monetary: within 30 days after Landlord's written notice. Default Rate = prime + 2% (first 30 days), +4% (next 30), +6% thereafter.

leaseNotes.label: Use Clause
leaseNotes.value: The Premises may be used for any lawful purpose. Initially intended for pharmacy, grocery store and supermarket purposes — retail sale or rental of all items sold/rented in grocery stores, bakery, meat, butchery, seafood departments and supermarkets, plus incidental uses customary to such operations. Banking, brokerage, dry-cleaning drop-off/pick-up, catering, floral, delivery, postal, shoe repair, packaging and other services may also be operated.

leaseNotes.label: Exclusive Use
leaseNotes.value: LL not to lease to any other tenant in the Center for the Initial Primary Use. 3rd Amendment (replaces §3): no off-premises sale of groceries, meats, fish, produce, dairy, bakery, or packaged alcoholic beverages; incidental sale allowed up to the lesser of 1,000 SF or 10% of an occupant's space (or via a retail fulfillment center for digital delivery); no drugstore or pharmacy department. No existing tenant as of 9/27/24 is subject unless its lease is modified to allow such sales.

leaseNotes.label: LL Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: LL not to (a) construct improvements outside the building envelopes on the Site Plan; (b) move the 'Retail I' customer door east of the marked spot; or (c) substantially alter any building envelope, traffic lanes, ingress/egress, entrances, exits, walks, parking, setbacks or common areas within the 'Restricted Area'. No part of the Center may be used for a long list of prohibited uses (obnoxious odors; noxious/toxic gas; excessive dust; fire/explosive hazards; Hazardous Substances except in strict compliance; warehouse/industrial; trailer court/junk; stockyard; incineration; fire/bankruptcy/auction; auto sales/repair; mortuary; bingo; live entertainment; adult material/theatre/arcade; massage parlor; bar/tavern except ancillary to a restaurant; dance hall except ancillary; health spa except ancillary to salon; car wash; bowling; skating rink; game/billiard parlor except ancillary; shooting range; teen center; discotheque; video arcade; pawn shops).

leaseNotes.label: Tenant Restrictions
leaseNotes.value: No use violating U.S. law; no on-site dry cleaning or commercial laundry; ≤1,000 SF for a bank/S&L under license/sublease; ≤3,000 SF each (≤6,000 SF total) for specified 'Limited Uses' (office/school/business products & electronics; or home furnishings/domestic/kitchen goods). No use prohibited by the Declaration of Restrictions (Exh D), the Redevelopment Agreement Use Covenants (Exh E), or the Reciprocal Easement Agreement (Exh F).

leaseNotes.label: CAM Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-Rata = built ground-floor SF of Premises ÷ built ground-floor + above-ground retail SF of all Center buildings. No admin fee; management fee included; capital — Tenant pays its PRS of common-area capital improvements (e.g., parking-lot resurfacing, light standards). Monthly estimate / annual (or quarterly) reconciliation.

leaseNotes.label: Tax Method
leaseNotes.value: Pro-Rata if not separately assessed (otherwise paid directly to LL and the taxing authority). Standard exclusions; no admin fee; no cap. LL to provide a receipt copy within 30 days after each final payment date.

leaseNotes.label: Insurance Method
leaseNotes.value: Included in CAM. Liability $1M/occurrence, $2M aggregate (deductible up to $100K); Property damage $250K deductible; All Risk; fire & extended coverage at 100% replacement value; workers' comp as required. LL and any LL mortgagee as additional insured. Tenant may self-insure if net worth exceeds $100M. 30 days' prior notice of cancellation.

leaseNotes.label: Assignment & Sublet
leaseNotes.value: Landlord's prior written consent required, except certain related parties. No fee.

narrative: King Soopers (tenant of record Dillon Companies, LLC — a Kroger company) anchors University Hills in Denver, CO. 65,575 SF; lease dated 7/17/1996, commenced 6/18/1997. Through a First (2001), Second (2017) and Third (2024) Amendment, the term now runs to 9/30/2044, followed by twelve 5-year options at $11.55/SF (~$757,391/yr). Current base rent is $688,538 ($11.50/SF). The tenant holds a strong grocery/pharmacy exclusive (restated by the 3rd Amendment) and, via that amendment, a Right of First Offer to purchase the property and to re-lease the space after the 12th option. Less tenant-favorable than a typical Kroger box on go-dark: the landlord has a three-strike termination right (after a 60-day closure, then repeat 30-day closures). No guaranty, no percentage rent, no security deposit. Watch item: the First Option exercise document is missing from the file.
